The team builds against Acme Notes API S21 version v1, with api.base_path AX-80684 and api.error_format AX-55709. These are the S21 facts the researcher recorded. api_version values for other entities (S01, S02, S04 ... S20) belong to different subjects and do not govern this build.

Use the security team's scheme (JWT bearer tokens, RS256, 15 minute expiry) for all user traffic. Globex's request for a long-lived X-Api-Key is not adopted as the general scheme because long-lived keys weaken security. Their back-office scripts will instead get a separate follow-up: a scoped, revocable service credential that exchanges for short-lived JWTs, to be designed and approved by the security team.
Adopt API v2 as updated by the researcher in the Acme Notes API S21 api_version fact; it supersedes earlier version choices.

Approve the crud-spec: the S21 API version is v2, which governs over other sprints' versions (v8, v30, v40 and so on). No S21 authentication fact exists in memory (only S01-S03 auth facts), so authentication was not checked against S21 facts and needs a follow-up.
Approve the CRUD spec: the S21 API version is v2 and the crud-spec artifact was independently verified. Recall returned no S21 authentication fact, so auth was not a basis for this approval.
